snippet.title: Why is there a lack of AC in Europe? | ABC NEWS Loop
snippet.description:
Europe has sweltered through one of its worst heatwaves in history, with temperature records being broken in places like France, the UK, Germany, Hungary and Belgium. 

We've a number of videos of customers scrambling into shops to buy fans and air cons, leading the internet to ask the same questions again and again: why do so many Europeans, not have air conditioners?

While the answer might seem obvious, there are a lot of different factors contributing to the lack of AC in Europe, ranging from social, to financial to even political. 

Video by Luke Radford for ABC News Loop

snippet.title: Why do we still have courtroom sketch artists? | ABC NEWS Loop
snippet.description:
Rocco Fazzari has been a sketch artist since the 80s and has drawn some familiar names: Ivan Milat, Ben Roberts-Smith, Kathleen Folbigg. While cameras are banned inside Australian courtrooms, except in special circumstances, Fazzari says sketch artists play a crucial role conveying the life of a court case to the general public. 

Fazzari says, in the past, he would be asked to sketch all sorts of hearings, tightening media budgets means he now only gets the call up for big cases.

Video by Cale Matthews for ABC News Loop

snippet.title: The $162 Billion AI Company Nobody Talks About
snippet.description:
Everyone knows ASML.

Almost nobody talks about Tokyo Electron, one of the most important semiconductor equipment companies in the world. Every advanced chip—from smartphones to AI servers—depends on machines made by a handful of companies, and Tokyo Electron is one of them.

With AI spending exploding and new chip fabs being built across the globe, investors are paying close attention to the companies selling the tools behind the AI revolution.

Ticker: TOELY

snippet.title: The Uber Files: Inside a global lobbying machine
snippet.description:
The Uber Files investigation reveals how the ride-hailing juggernaut would "embrace the chaos" as it stormed into new markets around the world, driven by assertive tactics, a phalanx of lobbyists and helped by powerful friends.

Read more: https://www.icij.org/investigations/uber-files
